coverage.scope: This local operation only; no service health assessment

availability.reason: Requires an explicit private job store. Writes require recording consent; job.work requires the explicit operator worker entry, current operation authority and a separately admitted runtime. No automatic service or replay.

capability.description: Private durable local jobs with immutable admission fingerprints, explicit worker ownership, separate host-capped runtime, monotonic retained events and no replay after uncertain dispatch. Submission grants no authority; extension jobs require the same exact current package and policy. job.work uses a separate explicit operator worker entry; hosted grants are unavailable.
